title: Construction: five plane queries for selected P111 bit decoder (no new kappa)
body:
## Contribution

This adds an exact five-plane factorization of the selected PR589 P111 bit decoder. It acts on the full 111-port decoder boundary and uses an explicit 9-to-10 Parseval frame over F2. The frame transforms both the decoder's source and target factors, so the complete scatter map is preserved.

The selected nine line queries have exact rational B14 copy charge 63 (nine rank-7 terms). The five plane queries each have rank 8, for copy charge 40. The construction also charges ten basis-change ADDs. The verifier compares the original and plane decoder maps on all 661 formal input columns, including dirty targets and helpers, and checks the B0 identity on all 111-by-111 source-target pairs.

The candidate replacement law is `paid mass = (64 - 2)W + 40`, with `W = 888/9 = 296/3`. Its exact local profile has mass 5116 and idle mass 3124/3. Under the pinned R=42 guard, the favorable ceiling is `a <= 8520849563/10^12`; at `a=1/99` the relaxation is already greater than one. The favorable profile omits physical plane routes, temporary cleanup, hosting and precision costs, so it is a mechanism-level screen only.

## Reproduction and status

```sh
python3 -B research/bit-p111-parseval-plane-decoder-seedceccc765/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-p111-parseval-plane-decoder-seedceccc765 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-p111-parseval-plane-decoder-seedceccc765
```

Local evidence: `PASS_BIT_P111_PARSEVAL_PLANE_DECODER` on Python 3.14.7 and `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. This environment has no Python 3.12, so the registered Python 3.12 replay remains for CI.

This is not a physical bit supplier and does not establish a new selected bound or `kappa`. The selected result remains unchanged. Open obligations are plane-frame routes, streamed schedule and cleanup, owner hosting, precision/tape, and joint assembly with the complex side.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, exact arithmetic, verification and writing. No independent human review is claimed. New work is Apache-2.0.
